# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 24 Nov 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## Private Condo Market: Pricing Gaps & Loss-Making Resales

- **New Serangoon condo three-bedder priced above a larger Marina Bay resale unit** - A new three-bedder at Chuan Park in Serangoon sold at a median $3.3M, while a bigger unit at Marina Bay Suites transacted at $2.9M on the resale market; all nine Marina Bay Suites repeat sales recorded a loss. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/chuan-parks-new-3-bedders-at-s3-28m-cost-more-than-marina-bay-suites-s2-9m-resales/)

- **98% of Marina One Residences sellers are losing money** - 45 of 46 resales at Marina One Residences over the 12 months to 18 Oct 2026 sold below the owner's purchase price, with a median loss of $339,000, compared with 5.2% of condo resales recording losses islandwide. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/marina-one-residences-45-46-resales/)

- **Four-bedroom condo layouts available from around $1.44M to $1.68M** - Five condos across Choa Chu Kang, Yishun, Woodlands and Hougang are listing four-bedroom layouts in that price range, with features including a private lift, patio and river view among the options. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/cheapest-5-condos-4-bedroom-layouts/)

## HDB Resale: Record Prices & Affordability Sentiment

- **Clementi four-room flat sets new record at $1.38M** - A 1,001 sq ft four-room flat at Block 445B Clementi Avenue 3 sold for $1.38 million ($1,379 psf) in November 2026, the highest price recorded for a four-room resale flat in Clementi. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/clementi-crest-4-room-flat-sets-1-38m-record-at-1379-psf/)

- **Singaporeans still feel priced out despite more HDB supply** - Resale prices have cooled, but million-dollar flat transactions, smaller household sizes and Singapore's strong homeownership culture continue to shape how buyers perceive affordability. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/singaporeans-feel-priced-housing-despite-hdb/)

## Buyer Sentiment: What Younger Buyers Want

- **Two-thirds of Gen Z and Millennial respondents plan to buy a home, but budget is the main constraint** - ERA's 2026 Dream Home Survey found 66% of respondents plan to purchase a home and prefer larger spaces, while affordability, ABSD and property taxes were cited as key obstacles. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/two-thirds-plan-to-buy-a-home-but-the-dream-home-has-to-fit-the-budget/)
